column2: [intro]
In my life, everything's organized
But sometimes, it really makes me sigh
The rules, the schedules, I can't take anymore
Monotony makes me feel so sore
Keeping order is such a bore
I just want to mess around some more
To let loose, to break free
Live my life without questioning me
Every day, I wear my suit and tie
But I dream of starting blocks, oh my
Acting wild, being a bit crazy
Stepping out of the frame, feeling free
Keeping order is such a bore
I just want to mess around some more
To let loose, to break free
Live my life without questioning me
[ solo ]
Life is too short to be dull and gray
So I'll enjoy, have fun today
Cause keeping order can wait, you see
Today I just want to live and be free
[ outro ]
